{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Drop duplicate patient_ids (keep first occurrence)
df_clean = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Replace sentinel value -999 with NaN for biomarker_baseline
df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999, pd.NA)

# Check if missing values in biomarker_baseline are random across sex
missing_by_sex = df_clean.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].apply(lambda x: x.isna().mean())
print("Proportion of missing biomarker_baseline by sex:")
print(missing_by_sex)

# Check if missingness is related to response
missing_by_response = df_clean.groupby('responded')['biomarker_baseline'].apply(lambda x: x.isna().mean())
print("\nProportion of missing biomarker_baseline by response status:")
print(missing_by_response)"}
